title: Reality of Prayer: Responding to the Creator's Acts with Knowledge, Love, and Gratitude

questions.question: How did the people answer when Allah showed them His mercy and kindness through good gifts?
questions.answer: They answered with thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: Who were they thanking?
questions.answer: They were thanking Allah, the true Giver.

questions.question: What do the many blessings in the whole world do?
questions.answer: They show praise and thanks to Allah.

questions.question: Where are these blessings described as being spread out?
questions.answer: They are spread through the universe and across the earth.

questions.question: What in the passage shows Allah’s generosity?
questions.answer: The many gifts and mercy He gives show His generosity.

questions.question: What kind of things are said to offer thanks by the way they are made?
questions.answer: The beautiful, orderly fruits of mercy and blessing do.

questions.question: How do those fruits give this message?
questions.answer: Their neat and balanced design shows it.

questions.question: What big idea does this passage teach about blessings?
questions.answer: Blessings should lead people to thank and praise Allah.

questions.question: What did the people do after seeing mercy and compassion in the blessings?
questions.answer: They gave thanks and praise.

questions.question: Why do they say no one can thank Allah enough?
questions.answer: Because Allah deserves more thanks than people can fully give.

questions.question: What does the passage say all blessings are doing?
questions.answer: They are praising and thanking Allah.

questions.question: How are blessings on the earth pictured?
questions.answer: They are shown like many gifts set out for everyone to see.

questions.question: What do the gifts in the world tell us about Allah?
questions.answer: They tell us He is generous and gives freely.

questions.question: What are people meant to notice when they look at these gifts?
questions.answer: They should notice Allah’s mercy, kindness, and care.

questions.question: Are only words used for thanks in this passage, or are created things also part of it?
questions.answer: Created things are also part of it.

questions.question: What should a believer learn from this passage?
questions.answer: A believer should see Allah’s gifts and be grateful to Him.

questions.question: Which feeling comes first in this passage when people see Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: Thankfulness comes first.

questions.question: What other feeling is joined with thankfulness?
questions.answer: Praise is joined with it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah and praise?
questions.answer: It says all praise belongs to Him.

questions.question: What fills the universe in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s blessings fill it.

questions.question: What do the blessings across the earth seem to announce?
questions.answer: They seem to announce praise for Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage use as an example of mercy and blessing that gives thanks?
questions.answer: It uses well-made fruits of mercy and blessing.

questions.question: Why do those fruits help people think of Allah?
questions.answer: Because their beauty and order show His giving and care.

questions.question: If a child enjoys food, plants, and other good things, what is a right response from this passage?
questions.answer: To thank Allah and praise Him.

questions.question: When people noticed Allah’s tender care in His gifts, how did they reply?
questions.answer: They replied with praise and thanks.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about thanking Allah fully?
questions.answer: It teaches that He deserves perfect thanks, but people cannot give enough.

questions.question: What do blessings themselves seem to do in the passage?
questions.answer: They seem to speak by showing praise and thanks.

questions.question: In what two large places are these blessings seen?
questions.answer: They are seen in the universe and on the earth.

questions.question: What can we understand about Allah from the many blessings around us?
questions.answer: We can understand that He is very generous and merciful.

questions.question: What is special about the fruits mentioned near the end of the passage?
questions.answer: They are orderly and beautiful, and they point to Allah’s mercy and bounty.

questions.question: How do these fruits give thanks before creatures?
questions.answer: Their excellent design and goodness show thankfulness to Allah.

questions.question: What is the main lesson of this passage for Muslim students?
questions.answer: We should notice Allah’s blessings and answer with shukr and praise.

questions.question: What was the people’s response to the sweet gifts given by Allah?
questions.answer: They responded with grateful praise.

questions.question: What does calling Allah the true Giver help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that all real blessings come from Him.

questions.question: What do all the blessings in the whole world do together?
questions.answer: They all show praise and thanks to Allah together.

questions.question: How are the blessings on earth pictured for the reader?
questions.answer: They are pictured like gifts laid out in a great place for people to see.

questions.question: What do these blessings show about Allah’s giving?
questions.answer: They show His kindness, generosity, and mercy.

questions.question: What kind of fruits are mentioned in this passage?
questions.answer: Fruits that are well-made, balanced, and full of mercy and blessing.

questions.question: What do those fruits witness to?
questions.answer: They witness to Allah’s generosity and openhanded giving.

questions.question: What should we remember when we see many good things around us?
questions.answer: We should remember to thank and praise Allah.

questions.question: What did the people do when they saw that Allah gives kind gifts to His creation?
questions.answer: They thanked Him and praised Him.

questions.question: Why is Allah called worthy of all thanks in this passage?
questions.answer: Because His gifts are many and His mercy is great.

questions.question: Where does the passage say these blessings can be seen?
questions.answer: They can be seen all over the universe and all across the earth.

questions.question: What message do the blessings seem to give to people?
questions.answer: They seem to say that Allah should be praised and thanked.

questions.question: What do the carefully made fruits show besides beauty?
questions.answer: They show Allah’s mercy, bounty, and generosity.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention creatures looking at these fruits?
questions.answer: To show that these signs are open for creation to see.

questions.question: What is one good way to act after reading this passage?
questions.answer: To be grateful to Allah for His blessings every day.
